message:
## Vulnerability Digest

**Scan window:** 2026-09-06 05:10 IST to 2026-09-07 05:10 IST (2026-09-05 23:40 UTC to 2026-09-06 23:40 UTC)

This scan used only `Products.txt` and `List_of_SIA_Completed.txt`. Obvious aliases were normalized and duplicate entries were merged. `DLL_software_component.txt` was not read or combined.

One credible advisory issued during the scan date directly matches a monitored product. No other high-confidence, in-window product matches survived freshness, relevance, source-quality, and deduplication checks.

### Google Chrome: multiple vulnerabilities, including an actively exploited V8 flaw

- **Affected product or component:** Google Chrome for Windows, macOS, and Linux
- **Vulnerabilities:** CVE-2026-85042 through CVE-2026-85053 (12 CVEs), consolidated as one advisory finding
- **Severity:** CVE-2026-85046 is High according to Google; the other CVEs have varying severities
- **Description:** The issues include memory-safety, type-confusion, race-condition, and input-validation flaws. The most serious could allow arbitrary code execution in the logged-on user's context after malicious web content is processed.
- **Why it is relevant:** Google Chrome is explicitly present in the assigned product scope.
- **Freshness:** MS-ISAC advisory 2026-088 was issued on 2026-09-06. Google originally published the underlying Chrome update on 2026-09-03, so this digest treats the September 6 advisory as the new report and does not mislabel the CVEs as newly disclosed today.
- **Threat status:** Google states that an exploit for CVE-2026-85046 exists in the wild.
- **Sources:** [MS-ISAC advisory 2026-088](https://www.cisecurity.org/advisory/multiple-vulnerabilities-in-google-chrome-could-allow-for-arbitrary-code-execution_2026-088); [Google Chrome Stable Channel update](https://chromereleases.googleblog.com/2026/09/stable-channel-update-for-desktop_01882797386.html)

### MongoDB ecosystem coverage

A dedicated sweep checked MongoDB Server (Community and Enterprise), mongod, mongos, Atlas and Atlas services, Ops Manager, Cloud Manager, Compass, mongosh, Database Tools, Kubernetes Operator, drivers, connectors, BI Connector, Charts, Realm and App Services, official integrations, and major maintained libraries and services. MongoDB's first-party alerts page showed its newest CVE notices dated 2026-09-03, outside this window; no credible MongoDB-family vulnerability was newly reported or materially updated in scope. Source: [MongoDB Alerts](https://www.mongodb.com/resources/products/alerts).

### Closing

Immediate review is recommended for Chrome deployments because CVE-2026-85046 is reported as actively exploited. Confirm that Chrome is at least 152.0.7977.82/.83 on Windows and macOS or 152.0.7977.82 on Linux, subject to normal change validation.
